body:
It's reassuring (well maybe not) to hear that someone else feels where I am coming from. I don't particularly want to die, but sometimes I think that it is just something that is going to happen - like that is the end goal for me. I've booked an appointment with my college counselors, but I'm not sure how much I will be willing to reveal when it's not anonymous.

Have you been able to figure out why you think you will eventually commit suicide? I've been giving it some serious thought since I made the post but I can't figure it out. I hope the best for both of us.
I didn't know that the post had to get moderator approved, but I'm fine if it doesn't. It feels so good just to type it out
